articles.summary: Cardiol Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: CRDL) (TSX: CRDL) is pleased to announce that it has entered into a sales agreement with Jefferies LLC for an at-the-market offering program.
articles.title: Cardiol Therapeutics Announces At-The-Market Equity Offering Program With Jefferies LLC

articles.summary: Cardiol Therapeutics recently brought together the health care professionals running our pivotal trial for the MAVERIC Phase III Investigators’ and Study Coordinators’ Meeting in New York City. The clinicians in the room treat recurrent pericarditis in their own practices, and their account of the disease (and of what patients need from a new therapy) explains a great deal about why the trial is designed the way it is.
articles.title: Recurrent Pericarditis: Through the Eyes of the Physicians Treating It
